ground_truth_root_cause: Deploy sha=449ee7cc0d6e (2026-05-13T10:41:00Z) modified services/payment-service/infra/db_pool_config.go as part of an infra ticket bundled into the sarama bump PR. The change reduced the database connection pool maximum from 25 to 5 (DB_POOL_MAX=5), matching a misconfigured infrastructure template intended for a staging environment. Under normal production traffic, the payment_ledger table is queried by account_id without a covering index, causing full sequential scans (2.4M rows) that hold connections for 4-8 seconds each. With only 5 connections available the pool is immediately exhausted at moderate concurrency, causing acquisition timeouts, circuit breaker activation, and 100% HTTP 503 error rate on all payment endpoints.
ground_truth_remediation: 1. Immediately hotfix db_pool_config.go to restore DB_POOL_MAX to 25 (or the previous production value) and redeploy payment-service to restore connection headroom within ~15 minutes. 2. Alternatively, roll back to the last known-good deploy (sha=6bb672061d65) via: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/payment-service`. 3. Once service is restored, add a missing index to eliminate sequential scans: `CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_payment_ledger_account_id ON payment_ledger(account_id);` — this prevents recurrence even under pool pressure. 4. Add a CI guard that validates DB_POOL_MAX is within an acceptable range (e.g., >= 20) before any deploy to production.
